title: pavia pallida
intro: Pavia pallida, commonly known as the 'pallid pavia', is a flowering plant species native to Mexico. It is a perennial plant known for its vibrant flowers and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Pavia pallida include its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its use in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant activity.
